verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe realtime transcription over WebSockets (Scribe v2 Realtime, under 150 ms latency). WebSocket support is listed alongside HTTP with official Python and Node.js SDKs, and voice activity detection is built in for live segmentation. Missing for 10: detailed WebSocket protocol documentation in the evidence (message schema, interim versus final results), independent or hands-on corroboration of realtime streaming.
